gbm_population_evidence.quote: Effect of Radiotherapy Concurrent of TTFields in Patients With Glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: [DEVICE] TTFields: The TTFields, consisting of low-intensity, 200 kHz frequency, alternating electric fields, was delivered (≥ 18 hours/d) via 4 transducer arrays on the shaved scalp and connected to a portable device.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The Clinical Effect and Safety of Radiotherapy Concurrent of TTFields in the Treatment of Post-operation Patients With Glioblastoma.
with a history of brain radiotherapy

role_evidence.quote: All patients received chemoradiotherapy (CRT) ( PTV-GTV: 60Gy at 2.0Gy per fraction, 5 fractions per week for 6 weeks; PTV-CTV: 54Gy at 1.8Gy per fraction, 5 fractions per week for 6 weeks) with a Temozolomide (TMZ) regimen（75mg/m2 per day during RT）

coder_notes: Device trial (TTFields concurrent with chemoradiotherapy), phase NA; the device is not listed as an agent. Temozolomide given in both arms -> soc_backbone; no candidate. Exclusion reason coded excluded_intervention_type (device); alternative is no_pharmacological_candidate. cns5_terminology historical only because the record uses 'glioblastoma multiforme' (in the brief summary's FDA-approval statement); no IDH or WHO reference. Setting inferred as newly diagnosed from post-operative chemoradiotherapy and exclusion of prior brain radiotherapy.
